notes.title: Goodbye, Sick Love!
notes.notes:
It's been more than a year since I launched Sick Love (my first RPG Maker game). Trying to understand if people would pay attention to my game, I created this project quickly and received a lot of honest feedback. After that, I started to work harder and other games were launched receiving your support. I would like to thank you all and say Sick Love will be hidden from the store to keep Male Doll's focus on adult LGBTQ+ content, especially the gay male one. If you haven't seen my upcoming releases, you can check them below!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227600/Villain_Project

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1222640/Cumming_Hotel__A_Gay_Furry_Slice_of_Life

Don't forget to follow my [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/maledoll]Steam Page[/url] to receive the news!

Cheers,

Victoria

notes.title: Yuki's Tale Demo Available - Want to join on Steam Closed Test?
notes.notes:
Hello, guys!

I'm very excited to say that I've finished Yuki's Tale Demo.  In this version you'll be introduced to the Argania Kingdom, Heart Beat Guild and the main adventure of the game.  It has at least forty minutes of gameplay and two gay adult scenes. 

[b]How can I play it? Will be free?[/b]
Yuki's Tale Demo is available and it's FREE!

[b]How can I join on Closed Test?[/b]
All you have to do is play the demo and write a review (a good or bad one) at  Steam (or at Itch.Io page). In each platform, it will be allowed one review per user. For people who already have Sick Love or will buy it, a review on that (a good or bad one) multiplies the chances of joining on Closed Test by three.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1004320/Sick_Love__An_RPG_Maker_Novel/

[b]When does the contest end?[/b]
I'll upload Yuki's Tale final version at Steam in the first week of March. The contest will end at the same time. I'll write a new publication with the winner's announcement.

If you have any doubts, please, reply to this topic.

Good luck to everyone and I hope you enjoy the first Adult Yaoi J-RPG of Male Doll Studio. 

Victoria <3
